symptoms: Vitamin B1/thiamine deficiency (Wernicke encephalopathy and beriberi)

management_steps.details: Must be administered before intravenous glucose in susceptible patients at risk of thiamine deficiency to prevent precipitation of Wernicke encephalopathy.

warnings: Administration of intravenous glucose precipitates Wernicke encephalopathy if administered before thiamine supplementation in susceptible patients.
